EEG requested 5 Jan 2025. Result not documented here.

28 Jan 2025 review: same prolonged shaking episodes reinterpreted as functional non-epileptic events. Corrects epileptic account carried forward in 1 Feb letter. First such reinterpretation anywhere in patient history.
Epilepsy ruled out 28 Jan 2025, still ruled out at 1 Feb consultation. Last event of any kind 20 Jan; no other types ever reported; no further events through 20 Feb.
EEG from 5 Jan request performed 22 Jan 2025.
Same EEG: normal report available to team 25 Jan 2025.
Patient: no events of any kind, 20 Feb–10 Aug 2025. No further epileptic-to-non-epileptic reclassifications in entire period.
Patient: lamotrigine never restarted, 29 Jan–10 Aug 2025 inclusive.
Records: zero EEG requests, 3 Feb–10 Aug 2025 inclusive.
